# Copilot Instructions

- Build the project as a polished solar energy platform using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- Keep the interface premium, responsive, and dashboard-oriented.
- Prioritize the V1 focus: dashboard, empresa, servicios, proyectos, clientes, cotizaciones, and Brand Studio.
- Maintain a clean structure and reusable UI components.
- Keep the app secure by design at the architecture level, even in the initial front-end implementation.
